name: dsh-taskfold
description: Named-task lifecycle for the DeepSeek Harness: begin → work → fold. Each task's span folds into a titled, span-scoped summary node while its exact original request context (messages as sent, reasoning included) is saved as a JSON artifact — read/grep it with any file tool, regenerate it anytime from the append-only log. Self-hosted compaction engine: runs in any composition, no preset or engine row required.
